notes.title: Sealed Draft, 100 New Cards, and more!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work on exciting new features and boring bug fixes. This patch will reset any runs in progress, if you want to finish your current run, switch to the v19 branch.

[h2]More ways to build a deck.[/h2]
In addition to a pile of random cards, you can now draft from a sealed pool of 40 cards, build your own deck, or import a deck code from a 3rd party site.

[h2]Over 100 New Cards.[/h2]
New locations and new heroes. Such as the reality warping Eyevolutionary. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43728299/34bdbd59e983f1e0175533e7cf83e900a3f1adf6.png[/img]

And the death defying World Betwixt.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43728299/8c5f152296a7dbf57841ba2f4cef9ad5c7dd1e6e.png[/img]

[h2]Demo Mode.[/h2]
Looking for zen? Turn on Demo mode and watch the computer play.

[h1]PATCH NOTES [/h1]
[list]
[*] Orbit and Gravito now correctly pull cards that were not played from hand
[*] Falcon, Zomboy, Furball and other effects that return cards to your hand can no longer exceed the hand size limit of 7
[*] Judge Quark now looks in his current lane when trying to find the highest power card on the board
[*] Auras now apply to cards after each reveal, not after all cards reveal.
[*] Auras are removed when changing zones
[*] Calypso draws 0 *cost* cards instead of 0-drops.
[*] Magician's Assistants now trigger On Play effects.
[*] Fixed several cards with on flip abilities that were not correctly tagged and weren't being affected by on flip multipliers or silencers.
[*] Aura multiplication effects now work correctly with Summoner's flip multiplication effect.
[*] Charon now reduces the cost of cards that you stole from your opponent's deck
[*] Cards that copy effects such as Doppelganger, now show the copied text the second time they flip.
[*] Fixed random elo changes on loss
[*] Imported decks are no longer overwritten by random decks
[/list]

notes.title: Enter the Cyberjungle is now in early access!
notes.content:
The next update is planned for about a month from now. We hope to add around fifty more hero cards and twenty-five more locations in that update. If all goes well, the update after that should include Steam Workshop functionality so you can easily share your art, balance changes, and new mechanics with the rest of the community.



KNOWN ISSUES

CARDS
[list]
[*]If Count Vlad discards The Wild Hunt, he gets the power before being upgraded, not after.
[*]Masked Magician's Assistants do not trigger on play effects
[*]Calypso does not pull cards that have been adjusted to be 0-cost (e.g. Psychic Twins)
[*]Doppelganger text does change to reflect it's new ability until after it has already flipped a second time
[*]End of turn locations swapped in on the same turn that they are supposed to activate do not activate.
[*]Captain Martian makes very poor decisions about trying to win the game.
[*]Auras do not take effect until after play effects in some circumstances
[*]Auras can persist on cards in the graveyard in some circumstances.
[/list]

Please report any other bugs you encounter on the Steam discussion boards.
